messages:
Noah: Quick sync from the postmortem 179: recurring p99 jumps tied to nightly batch jobs. Need clear owners + dashboards.
Priya: I'll take ownership of the KV cache remediation (TKT-511). Target: prototype in 10 days, rollout next sprint.
Zoe: I'll do routing changes to isolate batch traffic (TKT-512). Plan: config canary -> monitor for 48h.
Ken: I'm updating alerts/dashboards. Proposal: don't change SLO text; adjust monitoring thresholds for 14 days only, plus an error-budget burn alert.
Noah: Agreed on not touching SLOs without sign-off. Ken, add a Prometheus panel for batch-volume and p99-by-pool.
Ken: Will add panel and a link to the postmortem. Alert change: p99 firing threshold 240ms -> 285ms (auto-revert in 14d). Runbook link attached.
Priya: Adding a CI perf test that simulates the batch window (CI-heat TKT-513) to catch regressions.
Zoe: Routing canary scheduled tonight at 02:30 UTC. I'll post canary link when live.
OpsBot: Canary scheduled: batch-routing-canary at 2026-04-02 02:30 UTC. Alert auto-revert scheduled in 14d.
Noah: Action list: Priya TKT-511 KV cache; Zoe TKT-512 routing canary; Ken dashboard + temp alerts; Priya CI test TKT-513; OpsBot to schedule weekly slo-trend reports.
Ken: I'll also add a weekly Slack digest to #eng-sre with p99 trend and error-budget consumption.
Noah: OK. If we see >2 spike days in a 7-day window, automatic follow-up meeting gets created and owners paged. Priya/Zoe update tickets as progress is made.
Priya: Will update postmortem with owners and links. Thanks.
